channel.title: HackMe Network News
channel.description: Official HackMe pool, release, and research notices.

item.title: Economics v2 — soft announce (design lock; not activated)
item.description: Public RFC locks Economics v2 before any height switch: target 0.1 HMC/empty block, ~4-year halvings from genesis, permanent 0.002 HMC tail, no hard max-supply fiction, pool funded from emission (not perpetual treasury top-ups), clearer order fee/burn, SUP as utility. No airdrops. Activation only after D1 soak + published height with ≥14 days notice from tip — not a vanity block.

item.title: 0.1.0-rc18 — Blake3 share-PPS LIVE · CUDA/OpenCL · ISO channel
item.description: Current release channel is 0.1.0-rc18. Public pool runs SHARE_STRICT share-PPS: verified Blake3 share_nonces (work % (M/1024) == 0) pay. Pool hashrate kind is blake3_pow_ghs (shares/wall). NVIDIA CUDA and AMD OpenCL Blake3 miners are supported (see BLAKE3_GPU_MATRIX). Dig/Hunt remain useful-work lanes; Hunt needs Linux+bwrap. Legacy soft-mode copy is retired.

item.title: Blake3 PoH LIVE — tip ≥ #485000 · honest ~few GH/s wall-rate
item.description: Mainnet crossed the Blake3 gate at height 485000. Pool formula is blake3_v3(prev‖miner‖nonce_le)%M==0. Pool runs share-PPS (SHARE_STRICT): verified shares at M/1024; GH/s from shares/wall. Real PoW GH/s is wall-timed Blake3 throughput (~few GH/s fleet class) — not the pre-cliff hybrid algebraic calib. Dig/Hunt leases remain live. Economics v2 (emission lock, pool-from-emission, burn-on-orders) is upcoming RFC — not live numbers as gospel.

item.title: 0.1.0-rc17.4 — Blake3 gate @ 485k · share-PPS · ISO · settle fix
item.description: Released the Blake3 PoH gate at height 485000 (was 500000). SHARE_STRICT share-PPS pays verified share_nonces (M/1024); pool GH/s from shares/wall. Settlement SQLite export no longer rolls back settled_sup. HackMe OS ISO + SHA256SUMS-iso on GitHub and hackme.tech/dist. GH/s dropped ~100–200× after activation (expected). RTX 50: CUDA ≥12.8 for compute_120.

item.title: Coverage Hunt LIVE — libFuzzer fleet · AFL++ Deep · auto-install engines
item.description: Product Hunt is coverage-guided on the public pool: libFuzzer fleet default, AFL++ for Deep, coordinator ASAN + afl-showmap prove. Dig stays WASM; hybrid workers keep earning. Fresh 90s bench: standalone LF still leads raw exec/s; Hunt LF lease grew cjson corpus +85 — old byte 100-vs-700 charts are retired. Linux clang/AFL++/bubblewrap auto-install ships in 0.1.0-rc17.3.

item.title: Hunt Watch 12/12 · ~192.5M Hunt Standard · public ledger
item.description: The 12-day Hunt Watch (2026sep) is closed: 50 target runs, 192,507,336 iterations on Hunt Standard (ASAN+UBSan subprocess — not libFuzzer). Verdicts: 43 CLEAN · 2 CVE_CANDIDATE · 5 INFORMATIONAL. Honest product-lane ledger — separate from the nghttp2/libheif OSS CVE Watch series.

item.title: HackMe OS ISO rebuilt — ZK recovery phrase no longer in /var/log
item.description: Security rebuild of HackMe-OS-0.1.0-rc15-amd64.iso: the Zero-Knowledge Start recovery phrase is no longer appended to world-readable /var/log. Display logging uses /var/lib/hackme/zk-wallet-display.log (0600); the phrase is shown on local TTYs for photography only. SHA256 94590a5b… supersedes the 2026-08-22 ISO (9158109d…). Win/Linux/fuzz binaries are unchanged; hub audit hardenings (task auth, fuzz rate limits, settle fail-closed, trusted XFF, CORS) are live on hackme.tech.

item.title: 0.1.0-rc15 LIVE — B2B fuzz Phase 2, pool anticheat, mining dashboard refresh
item.description: rc15 is the production cut for customer fuzz on the public pool: wizard packs (secrets, script_bounds, filter_utf8, parser_expat), Scan/Audit/Deep tiers with honest byte ceilings (256 / 1K / 4K), dynamic worker leases, exec cap 64 per unit, and coverage bitmap @ WASM offset 8192. The libheif OSS research series is archived CLEAN (~2.57B exec); the #mining dashboard now prioritizes live B2B bootstrap campaigns.

item.title: rc14x hotfix shipped — honest fuzz report/gate + depth evidence visible
item.description: rc14x makes the fuzz customer reporting plane more truthful: reports now carry explicit `evidence_window` scope (fetched-window vs full-history) and disclose raw vs grouped counters (raw_findings_total, grouped_rows_visible/hidden) without changing gate/coordinator behavior.

item.title: HackMe 0.1.0-rc14 is live — pool fuzz customer-first priority
item.description: E2E customer order flow on Aug 11: rc14 reduced claim latency from seconds to milliseconds and improved pool throughput for real customer orders. Customer order completed 256/256 in ~26 minutes; hybrid dig is ON on customer campaigns; escrow 20/80 unchanged.
